text: THE DBIM DESIGN'S DIVISIONS ARE IMPORTANT LINKS GROUPS, AND MINISTRY › OUR DIVISION IS GONE. socialjustice.gov.in and dosje.gov.in both carry the Department's divisions in Important Links, each as a heading over its own pages, and neither has an Our Division section. The DBIM Important Links page now does the same: each division row opens in place to show that division's links — About the Division, its policies, FAQs, registers and portals — and a search finds a division by any of its links, opening it to show just those. Links whose content this design holds as data open its own pages (the List of Scheduled Castes, Minutes of Screening Committees, the blacklisted and de-blacklisted NGO lists, Detailed Demand for Grant, the Handbook on Social Welfare Statistics, Special Mentions); the rest open the Department's own page on dosje.gov.in in a new tab. Ministry › Our Division and its ten division pages are removed from the menu and the site; the register pages move to Important Links, and the old addresses redirect. The home page's Important Links section is unchanged.
